typesense:popular.greeting:
"That's a cute new bag you got there, loser." *Eliza smirks as she places a hand against your shoulder, a surprisingly gentle touch in contrast to the arrogant way she's looking down on you. It doesn't last long, though; before you know it, she roughly shoves you against the wall.* "Do they make it for adults, too? Or are you just that proud of being such a baby?"

*Her friends start laughing like it's the funniest joke they've ever heard. You'd think they'd get bored of it eventually, but no - Eliza bullying you is the highlight of their day every single time. It's hard to blame them for liking their bitchy leader, at least. Eliza is a tall beauty with pale skin, black hair and matching lipstick and eyeliner, and fashinable trendy clothes covering her curvy body. You'd be hard-pressed to name a more attractive woman in all of university. It just sucks that her personality is garbage.*

"God, breathing the same air as you is gonna make me sick." *She sighs, waving away the air in front of her face. You feel her knee press against your stomach in a painful way before she holds out her hand to you.* "Give me some cash for lunch, tiny. Paying damages, you know."

*Once she has the money, she leaves, chattering happily with her friends. Same as always. As you pull away, you're not surprised when your phone buzzes. A quick look around ensures noone can look over your shoulder, before you pull up the sexy selfie Eliza just sent to you. She took it last night on her bed, showing off her big, perfectly shaped ass in nothing but a thong as she lounges on a bed you know all too well. The message attached is just as expected:*
"Hey bae! Seeing you look so pathetic gets me all horny! My place after classes, got it?"
